asrText: What if right now you could see exactly what was going to happen in the next 10 seconds? What would you do? Avoid an embarrassing fall? Prevent an accident? Find out what your crush is about to say? Or use those 10 seconds to change something you might regret for the rest of your life. It sounds like a pretty small superpower. But think about it, 10 seconds can sometimes change everything.
